event.description: Train shared width 15 on full-range operands
event.proposal: Family: training control. Current retained frontier is 2,128 parameters at 99.140000%, a +0.140000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There has been 1 prior attempt in this family: attempt-0002 is the accepted 45k-step schedule extension under an older architecture, and there is no failed in-family result. The most recent experiment, attempt-0036 in attention organization, peaked at 93.45% internal validation. Crucially, attempt-0032 showed the fully shared width-15 model reaching 98.75% while its training sampler chose operand digit lengths uniformly from 1 through 10, heavily overrepresenting short numbers relative to uniform sampling over the official 0..10^10 range. Hypothesis: training both operands directly over the full 10-digit range focuses limited width-15 capacity on the evaluated distribution and crosses 99%, yielding 2,096 parameters. This is more informative than simply extending the schedule because the prior curve had already annealed to zero learning rate; distribution alignment changes the information seen within the same bounded 45k budget.
